contracts.protection_obligation: No artifact revision or new artifact may be committed to persistent storage when the generation-time dependency manifest (artifact id/revision/digest, source id/version/digest, profile id/version/snapshot, run input digest) no longer matches current store state; immediately before the write, inside the same store transaction, deps.assert_manifest must re-verify the recorded manifest, and any drift must abort the commit with DependencyConflict carrying status 409 (annotated by conflict_context with phase 'before_commit').
scope_limits: The manifest check fires only when a dependencies manifest is present: create_artifact falls back to run['_commit_guards'][kind] (operations.py 81-83) and revise_artifact asserts only when dependencies is not None (operations.py 129); commits made without a manifest are not drift-guarded.
Guarded content covers the artifacts, sources, profiles, and optional run-input digest recorded in the manifest (dependencies.py 95-126); it does not guard arbitrary database state.

Two documented bridges narrow the forbidden condition: legacy v2.7 digests are accepted only for the exact same immutable revision (dependencies.py 156-170), and superseded clarification evidence only for the recorded retirement transition (dependencies.py 68-92).

contracts.protection_obligation: Every HTTP request served by the FastAPI app must pass a host-allowlist and same-origin gate in the 'local_origin' middleware before any route handler executes: requests whose Host header is not on the configured allowlist are rejected with HTTP 403, and state-modifying requests (methods other than GET/HEAD/OPTIONS) carrying an Origin header that does not match the request Host and scheme are rejected with HTTP 403.
scope_limits: This is a transport-level host-allowlist and same-origin (CSRF-style) guard applied uniformly to all HTTP traffic; no supplied source registers it as an agent tool, agent lifecycle hook, or agent-input filter, so absent an explicit agent binding it falls in the ordinary-web-protection exclusion zone of the study scope.
The Origin check is skipped entirely for GET/HEAD/OPTIONS and for requests without an Origin header; only Origin-bearing state-modifying requests are compared.

The Host check accepts the default LOCAL_HOSTS set {'127.0.0.1','localhost','::1','testserver'} plus comma-separated TCG_ALLOWED_HOSTS values; actual runtime configuration values are outside the supplied source.
The gate protects request dispatch generally and does not distinguish agent-run-starting routes (e.g., POST /api/chats/{chat_id}/messages leading to engine.start_run) from any other route.
The middleware returns its 403 responses before any route-level validation or business code runs; it does not itself validate request bodies or credentials.
